text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for a 'turning point' in history." 
The far-reaching goal set with Mejiro 
Ardan for the Senior tier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was an endless list of things I 
needed to do as her Trainer to make that 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, like any other day, I have a 
mountain of tasks. The phrase "swamped 
with work" flickers across my mind, but 
that doesn't mean I can back down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ardan puts in desperate effort 
every single day, cherishing every moment 
to achieve her grand ambition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I must match that sheer 
desperation of hers……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with renewed determination, I sat down 
at my desk...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Time flew by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as the sun began to dip, it happened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps due to accumulated fatigue, an 
overwhelming drowsiness suddenly struck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so... this is no time to rest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you all right? It looked like you 
fell asleep sitting up..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking out the window, I realized the sun 
had completely set before I even knew 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"—You've been working this whole time, 
haven't you? Thank you for your hard 
work."
choice_data_list: I think I dozed off just now, though...
I think I dozed off just now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It was a privilege to witness such a 
rare sight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Why don't you take a rest for today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Lately, while you've been working harder 
than ever, Trainer, it also seemed like 
you've been pushing yourself too hard, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Mejiro Ardan's daily efforts, 
something like this doesn't count as 
pushing myself. That was what I replied, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —No, it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her expression was gentle, Mejiro 
Ardan's words carried a distinct weight 
that sought to confront reality head-on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...A Trainer so exhausted as to fall 
asleep on the spot, to my knowledge, this 
is a first."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, if it was a sudden bout of sleep 
she herself wasn't even aware of... it is 
not something we can simply overlook.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When the person who claimed they would 
guard my absolute last line of defense is 
in this state, don't you think that's a 
problem?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And with that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Judging by how you are, you must 
have been so focused that you completely 
forgot what day it is today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For always doing so much for me... Thank 
you, truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since it's homemade, it may have its 
flaws, but please enjoy this and take a 
breather today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate Mejiro Ardan made for me was 
crafted so beautifully it could be 
mistaken for store-bought—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With a single bite, a texture like light 
snow and a gentle sweetness spread across 
my mouth—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...How did it taste?
choice_data_list:
It's so delicious... it's seeping right 
through me... through my whole body...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! I'm honored to hear you say so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, I'll brew some tea as 
well. Please enjoy the food while you 
wait.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling Mejiro Ardan's kindness, it became 
a night where I swore to myself not to 
overdo it for her sake...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trai———ne—— ——come——plea———-san——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Have you awakened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was looking up at the 
ceiling, with Mejiro Ardan leaning over 
and peering down at me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"You fell asleep slumped over your desk, 
and I thought that would be bad for your 
body, so I took the liberty of doing 
this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I realized that I was 
currently resting my head in Mejiro 
Ardan's lap—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's dangerous to sit up so suddenly. You 
seem exhausted, so please stay lying down 
a bit longer—
choice_data_list:
Still, I'm still in the middle of work, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:

haven't you? Thank you for your hard 
work."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure it's because you're tired that 
the sweets taste all the better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the time, wouldn't it be 
best to eat something while letting your 
body rest?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My lap is open, you know. If you'd like... 
would you care to rest here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding— Fufu. Whether you take that 
as a joke or not, I will leave entirely up 
to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were some surprises along the way, 
but it was a heartwarming time filled with 
Mejiro Ardan's kindness...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't push myself too hard, for her 
sake as well. That night, I made a silent 
vow in my heart...
